payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear relationship between the mixing efficiencies, kappa(m) and kappa(v), as components of the overall diffusion coefficient.

claims.text: The overall diffusion coefficient κ is the sum of the molecular diffusivity (κ m ) and wave-induced diffusivity (κ v ).
The mixing efficiencies kappa(m) and kappa(v) are represented as κ m and κ v respectively in the advection-diffusion equation.
The relationship between kappa(m) and kappa(v) indicates that both contribute to the mixing process in the fluid.
